c1e086654e47: Calculate the equivalent capacitance of capacitors, or the equivalent inductance of inductors, in series or in parallel, with the voltage, charge and energy distribution across the capacitors when a voltage is applied.
6bf049d03b64: Example: three capacitors in series across 12 V.
0a29a79b30ab: Voltage is zero; leave it empty if not needed.
b07f7302844b: In series: the same charge flows through each capacitor, and the larger voltage appears across the smaller capacitor.
456c43d14c12: In parallel: the same voltage is across each capacitor, and the charge is proportional to the capacitance.
fdb84f8bf33c: We assume there is no mutual inductance between the inductors (i.e., they are far apart or shielded).
